<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_VacationRequest" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/vacation-request">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_VacationRequest" name="Vacations Request" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_VacationRequest">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Employee" name="Employee">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_RequestSubmitted</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SubmitRequest</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RegisterRequest</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReviewRejectionReasons</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_RequestRejected</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Supervisor" name="Immediate Supervisor">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReceiveRequest</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ApproveOrRejectRequest</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ApprovalDecision</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_NotifyHR</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_HR" name="Human Resources Representative">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CompleteHRProcedures</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_RequestProcessed</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_RequestSubmitted" name="Vacation request submitted">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_StartToSubmit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SubmitRequest" name="Submit vacation request">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_StartToSubmit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SubmitToRegister</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_RegisterRequest" name="Register vacation request">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SubmitToRegister</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RegisterToReceive</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReceiveRequest" name="Receive vacation request">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RegisterToReceive</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReceiveToApprove</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ApproveOrRejectRequest" name="Approve or reject request">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReceiveToApprove</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ApproveToDecision</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ApprovalDecision" name="Request approved or rejected?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ApproveToDecision</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Rejected</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Approved</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ReviewRejectionReasons" name="Review rejection reasons">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Rejected</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReviewToEndRejected</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_RequestRejected" name="Request rejected and returned to employee">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReviewToEndRejected</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_NotifyHR" name="Send notification to HR representative">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Approved</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotifyToHR</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CompleteHRProcedures" name="Complete vacation management procedures">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotifyToHR</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_HRToEndProcessed</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_RequestProcessed" name="Vacation request processed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_HRToEndProcessed</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartToSubmit" sourceRef="StartEvent_RequestSubmitted" targetRef="Task_SubmitRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SubmitToRegister" sourceRef="Task_SubmitRequest" targetRef="Task_RegisterRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RegisterToReceive" sourceRef="Task_RegisterRequest" targetRef="Task_ReceiveRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReceiveToApprove" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveRequest" targetRef="Task_ApproveOrRejectRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ApproveToDecision" sourceRef="Task_ApproveOrRejectRequest" targetRef="Gateway_ApprovalDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Rejected" name="Rejected" sourceRef="Gateway_ApprovalDecision" targetRef="Task_ReviewRejectionReasons"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Approved" name="Approved" sourceRef="Gateway_ApprovalDecision" targetRef="Task_NotifyHR"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReviewToEndRejected" sourceRef="Task_ReviewRejectionReasons" targetRef="EndEvent_RequestRejected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotifyToHR" sourceRef="Task_NotifyHR" targetRef="Task_CompleteHRProcedures"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_HRToEndProcessed" sourceRef="Task_CompleteHRProcedures" targetRef="EndEvent_RequestProcessed"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
